name: Clam AI
summary: Permission layer that lets AI agents work in Gmail through MCP while seeing and doing only what plain-English rules allow, with every action logged.
description: Permission layer that lets AI agents work in Gmail through MCP while seeing and doing only what plain-English rules allow, with every action logged.

pricing.details: Starter 3 €/month — 2,000 classified emails a month. Pro 6 €/month — 4,000 classified emails a month. Every account starts with a 14-day free trial of Starter, no card; after the trial this is a paid product, so the lot label is Premium. Official promo: sign up for an annual plan before the end of 2026 and the first year is 27 € on Starter or 64 € on Pro (two months offered); you are reminded before renewal. That first-year amount is a promo, not the normal list price. Clam does not charge overage; requests that would exceed the monthly cap are denied until the next monthly reset.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Connect Gmail and give each agent a Shell whose plain-English rules are compiled into Cedar policies
Agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok connect through MCP to triage, summarise and draft, with approvals
An audit log of every action; email content is not stored
Starter 3 €/month (2,000 classified emails/month) and Pro 6 €/month (4,000). Every account starts with a 14-day Starter trial, no card — this is a trial, not a lasting free plan

Official promo: subscribe to an annual plan before the end of 2026 and the first year is 27 € on Starter or 64 € on Pro (two months offered). That first-year amount is a promo, not the normal list price. No overage charges; requests over the cap are denied until the next reset

Starter 3 €/mois (2 000 e-mails classés/mois) et Pro 6 €/mois (4 000). Chaque compte commence par un essai Starter de 14 jours, sans carte — c’est un essai, pas une offre gratuite durable

Promo officielle : une souscription annuelle avant la fin 2026 donne une première année à 27 € sur Starter ou 64 € sur Pro (deux mois offerts). Ce tarif de première année est une promo, pas le prix de liste normal. Pas de frais de dépassement ; les demandes au-delà du plafond sont refusées jusqu’au prochain reset
